title: ResponsivePopover
description: UI5 responsive popover: desktop popover, full-screen phone dialog with header and footer slots.

usage.summary: Keep contextual content anchored on desktop and tablet, then show it in a full-screen phone dialog.
useWhen: Let users inspect or edit information related to an opener across desktop, tablet and phone.
Use it when contextual content would take more than one-third of the phone screen.
Provide a phone title and closing action through headerText and closeLabel, or replace the phone bars with phoneHeader and phoneFooter.

avoidWhen.when: Keep lightweight contextual content anchored on every device and within one-third of the phone screen.
Require a focused modal task and explicit confirmation on desktop as well as phone.
Show commands in menu rows or submenus without mixed contextual content.
Show a bottom-aligned list of actions with Cancel on phones.
